query:
SELECT u.email, u.id as user_id, u.created_at,
       ch.id as conv_id, ch.created_at as conv_date, ch.feature, ch.status
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN conversion_history ch ON ch.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'ladaatn@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ch.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
